description: React component for a drag-and-drop filter selection control in Apache Superset, managing filters, metrics, and columns with dynamic options and popover interactions.

methods.name: optionsForSelect
methods.description: Generates sorted options for columns and metrics, including adhoc metrics, for filter selection.

methods.name: mapOption
methods.description: Converts a selected option into an AdhocFilter instance based on its properties.

methods.name: onNewFilter
methods.description: Adds a new filter based on user input.

methods.name: togglePopover
methods.description: Shows or hides the filter popover.

methods.name: valuesRenderer
methods.description: Renders the list of current filters.

methods.name: handleClickGhostButton
methods.description: Handles click on the ghost button to add a new filter.

methods.name: canDrop
methods.description: Determines if a dragged item can be dropped into the filter area.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles dropping an item into the filter area.
